## Services

- Interior Painting (bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens, bathrooms, basements, hallways, staircases, full house)
- Exterior Painting
- Kitchen Cabinet Painting (spray finish)
- Commercial Painting
- Drywall Repair

## Service Area

Toronto, North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, Vaughan, Woodbridge, Richmond Hill, Markham, Newmarket, Aurora, King City, Mississauga.

## Key Differentiators

- Licensed and fully insured (WSIB + liability)
- Free written estimates within 12 hours
- 2-year workmanship warranty
- Thorough prep and clean-up included
- Satisfaction walkthrough at project end
